# Add — keep an idea or work worth resuming

Resolve the selected home and project using `references/workspace-records.md`.
Read its storage policy and relevant existing records before writing. Search for an
existing owner; an addition to the same idea or task updates that record. Apply
`references/saving.md` and read `references/record-interface.md` only for retained writes.

Choose the destination yourself from the user's meaning and conversation; do not
ask the user to choose a folder or record type. A possibility, observation or
uncommitted suggestion is an idea. A decided outcome or requested queued work is a
task, even before execution is authorized. Specific implementation detail alone does
not establish a decision to pursue it. Reuse the original owner for related progress.
Honor an explicit destination. If commitment remains unclear, keep it as an idea and
preserve that uncertainty; ask only when a consequential ambiguity prevents a faithful
save. Briefly report the chosen destination after saving.

Choose from the user's intent:

- **Idea.** Capture a thought the user wants to keep without manufacturing work.
  Use `ideas/<topic>.md` with the idea and why it matters. Preserve uncertainty;
  do not invent deliverables, acceptance, a deadline or permission to implement.
- **Task.** Record work the user intends to do in `tasks/<topic>.md`. Keep the goal,
  scope, execution authorization and observable completion conditions explicit.
  Unstarted work is `planned`; unresolved choices remain visible. A priority or a
  saved task alone does not grant execution authority. An engineering plan can live
  in that task when needed; do not create a parallel plan or index.
- **Working thought.** Save requested temporary exploration in `thoughts/<topic>.md`
  with `retention: working`, the question/evidence and an exit condition. It can retire
  after useful content has a durable owner and references/recovery are checked.
- **Retained document.** Save requested long-term project knowledge, reference material
  and independently reusable rationale in an existing/new `docs/<topic>.md` with
  `type: doc`. Keep it in the selected Home when private; product contributor docs
  remain in their code repository. Keep uncertainty and sources explicit. Read the
  retained-doc contract in `references/workspace-records.md` before either write.
- **Progress or session save.** Inspect the mapped code, Git HEAD, working diff and
  actual checks before updating the original task. Keep verified results, limits,
  operative reasons, next action and owner-owned gates. Stopping a session does not
  pause the task. Mark it paused only when the user puts that task aside, and done
  only after its acceptance passes, including required human judgment.

Keep the existing record's language and shape. Preserve unrelated content and useful
reasons. Change project priorities only on an explicit priority-setting request.
An idea becomes a task only when the user decides to pursue it; preserve useful
context without duplicating the same progress into both records.

Keep task-specific evidence in an optional sibling `tasks/<topic>/` folder only when
its original state is needed later. Independent reusable knowledge may have a doc
owner; ordinary work needs no separate thought, doc, mockup or probe record. Legacy
thoughts remain in place until their migration is explicitly selected.

Read `references/session-handoff.md` and `references/legacy-blueprints.md` only when
an existing legacy record owns the work. Save in place; do not migrate it as a side
effect. Report what was saved and what remains pending. A save-only request ends
there; implementation requires existing execution scope. Before reporting saved,
apply **Verify a retained write** in `references/record-interface.md` to every card
created or changed, and report the check's scope and remaining uncertainty.
